args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18 since the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Incident opened to track follow-up on root cause of v2.3.1.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1, unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was approved and completed successfully.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0; the on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows v2.3.0 healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.
